reviewedRevision: 1fadde4 plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-course shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. It passed; a MEDIUM tuning note on the hardest courses and two LOW items were fixed and verified by re-running the reviewer's own pilot and blind scripts, one clean-worktree run and the browser check, without a second review round.
independentProbes: On the final files the reviewer's prompt-following pilot (status line seen 0.35 s late, 60 Hz, 20 seeds) cleared the mastery courses 15-20 in 112 of 120 runs (93.3%), losing 0.91 attempts per run, with the final Grand Ridge at 18 of 20. Ninety-eight blind patterns per course on courses 3-20 cleared 13 of 1,764 runs (0.74%), the softest being course 12 at 11%. In the review round courses 1-14 cleared at or near 100% with almost no attempts lost; pitch pumping in still air gained no energy, circling a thermal for 600 s topped out 23 m above it, a full dive at 30 Hz never tunnelled, scripted flights matched across five frame rates, a 20,000-frame hostile fuzz was clean, and progress stores, the queued crash-pause confirm and text fit all passed.

findings.observation: Only 3 courses in a partial table, with no select or continue. There are now 20 data-driven courses (teaching 1-7, combination 8-14, mastery 15-20) with thermals, crosswinds, gusts, sink zones, gates, windows and shelf and pin landings, accurate EN/ZH tips, a course select and env.progress continue; a confirm during the crash pause is queued, gates and sink zones carry ticks, pointers and labels, and the 1,381-line file is split into seven modules.

Review finding: at 0.35 s the hardest courses were tight (mastery 78.3%, Grand Ridge 12 of 20). Gates on Needle Crest, Long Haul and Grand Ridge were widened and Grand Ridge's post-thermal windows retuned, so mastery clears 93% while still costing about 0.9 attempts per run.
The final win text now says all twenty ridges (二十条山脊) instead of three, and clearing course 20 is saved and shown as cleared.

openNotes: Course 12 (Leeward Gate) is the softest against blind periodic pitch patterns at about 11%, under the 25% cap.
Razor Windows is the hardest course, clearing 16 of 20 for the 0.35 s pilot.
A missed gate is only recoverable by flying back, which the prompts guide but can feel slow.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened course 1 of 20 (Warm-up Spur) with the air, vertical-speed and altitude readout, a numbered gate marker with distance and pointer, the plan inset and the course tip, the glider unobscured.
Holding nose-down flew through all three gates of the gentle first course without a crash; the status then prompted 'Too fast: hold Up'.
English 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): touch buttons Nose up, Nose down, Bank left, Bank right and Flare, with the course and inset readable.
Not covered in the browser: a crash-out loss and a landing win; the reviewer's pilot and the quality tests cover them.
